chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Abī Khālid, from Abī Ḥamzah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
A man does not wash a woman, unless no woman is found; and that does not contradict that.
ai.seo_question: Can a man wash a deceased woman if no woman is available?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the washing of a deceased woman by a man, allowing it only when no woman is available. It belongs to the jurisprudential discussion of funerary rulings and spousal handling of the deceased.
